audit.whatIsWrong: QA lint pass: dosFull[1].d was verbatim tradeGood and dontsFull[2].d was verbatim tradeBad (copy-paste bleed).
audit.why: Deterministic lint (COPY_PASTE_BLEED). Locke kit: Ritual Nails (Q) marks; Ashen Pursuit (E) is a short 425-range teleport-dash, so a tower freeze denies his step-up.
audit.corrected: Both bled bullets rewritten to match their own titles using kit-verified mechanics already established in this matchup's text.

edits.before: Lock gold off-screen, walk up once, card-auto-Q, and leave — one stun-chunk per cycle is all the lane asks of you.
edits.after: Hold the wave by your tower and clear with Wild Cards — his nail marks need him close, and a freeze denies the step-up.

edits.before: Cycling cards inside his engage range for stacked-deck greed — TF dies in exactly one mistimed auto-walk per game; don't pre-book it.
edits.after: Chipping plates with the gold card down is when his blink-in finds you — with the stun spent, the nail engage goes unanswered; back off.

notes: QA-phase lint-fix proposal only (locke has no packet/games entry, so no earlier proposal file existed).
